posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Giddy up. The Brewers and Padres are working out at AmFam Field today.
posts.jp: よし、行こう。BrewersとPadresがAmFam Fieldで練習中だ。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Braves 6, Phillies 2. The season ends in the Wild Card Series, and a long winter awaits the Phillies.
posts.jp: Braves 6、Phillies 2。シーズンはワイルドカードシリーズで終了、Philliesは長い冬を迎える。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: It's closing time for the Phillies. Ozzie Albies homers off Zack Wheeler to make it 5-0.
posts.jp: Philliesのシーズンは終わり。Ozzie Albiesがミスターをホームランで4点目。

posts.author: Jen McCaffrey
posts.text: Red Sox announce Mickey Gasper underwent a successful Distal Biceps tendon repair today
posts.jp: Red Soxが発表：Mickey Gasperが本日、上腕二頭筋腱の修復手術に成功。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Jed Hoyer on how he will approach spending on relief market: “I did a poor job in the bullpen this year — full stop. … So I take responsibility for that and something that we'll look to improve on this offseason because it didn't work out as well as it did in ‘25 this last year.”
posts.jp: Jed Hoyerがリリーフ市場への支出方針：「リリーフ投手の起用で今季失敗した。責任を取り、オフシーズンに改善するつもりだ。'25年ほどうまくいかなかった」

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: Happy @mlbtraderumors.bsky.social arbitration projection day to you and yours. It was a good year for Peter Lambert. It will be a more difficult winter for whoever is running the Astros’ baseball operations department
posts.jp: アービトレーション予想日おめでとう。Peter Lambertにとっていい年だった。Astrosの野球運営部門を担当する者にとっては厳しい冬が待っている。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Jed Hoyer on the Cubs’ season: “Ultimately, as we sit here today, it feels like we let something slip away and I think that's probably the hardest thing. These fans deserve home playoff games. We let home field slip away by playing poorly in September, especially the last week.”
posts.jp: Jed Hoyerが今季を振り返る：「結果的に、チャンスを逃してしまった。ファンはホーム球場でのプレーオフに値する。9月の不振で、特に最終週で本拠地を失わせてしまった」

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Murakami just took Messick 440 feet. 2-0 White Sox.
posts.jp: 村上宗隆がMessickから440フィートの本塁打！White Soxが2-0とリード。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: With the Cubs’ season officially over now that Jed Hoyer held his annual year-end presser, just wanted to say I appreciate all the Cubs fans who followed along and read my work this season. More to come in the offseason!
posts.jp: Jed Hoyerの年末会見でカブスのシーズンが正式に終了。今シーズン応援いただいたカブスファンの皆様に感謝します。オフシーズンも続きます！

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.jp: 恒例の空のスタジアムの写真📸

posts.author: Jen McCaffrey
posts.text: ICYMI and need a little levity this weekend: Talked to 20 people to gather 10 stories on what it's like to know Payton Tolle and why he is the way he is. “We’re in the entertainment business. And he’s purely entertaining.” www.nytimes.com/athletic/764...
posts.jp: 見落とした方向け、週末の息抜きに：Payton Tolleのことを知る20人に話を聞き、彼がなぜこんな人間なのかを10つの物語に。「俺たちはエンタメ業界にいる。彼は純粋にエンタメだ。」

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Ipswich Town, League One champions in 2034!
posts.jp: イプスウィッチ・タウン、2034年のリーグワン優勝！

posts.author: Bobby Nightengale
posts.text: Taylor Rogers was the only Twins reliever who went wire-to-wire on the roster. His stats were unspectacular, but his influence on young arms will last. “Little things that go unnoticed, but when you hear about it, you’re like, ‘I’m not surprised.’ That’s him.” www.startribune.com/minnesota-tw...
posts.jp: Taylor Rogersはツインズのリリーフ投手の中で唯一シーズン通して登録され続けた。成績は地味だが、若い投手たちへの影響は長く残る。「気づかない小さなことだが、聞いてみると『納得だ』ってなる。それが彼だ」

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Misiorowski out of the 'pen between starts? 'It's not out of the question' www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
posts.jp: Misiorowski、先発と先発の間にリリーフ登板？「あり得ないわけではない」
